name: Carlos Stinson
text: I once struggled inside since leaving the military after my service of 4 Operation Iraqi Freedom campaigns of my 7 years in service as airborne special operations /global response task force. By becoming part of Nashville MMA East/ Team Shawn Hammonds, I was given a new meaning to my life. This is the place where I can come to feel welcomed and not judged based on my service-connected disability. I love the diversity in this organization, the friendliest, excellent staff and top of the line instructors. With new hope in my life, I truly don’t see myself going anywhere else as to be focused on my future investment with this sport organization in becoming BJJ competitor, physical fitness, instructor, or even possible a referee. I would like to encourage any military and Veterans in being part of this great organization.

name: Jason Giger
text: I’ve been working out and training at Nashville MMA for almost 9 months and really love it. It can be an intense gym, but that is what you want in a gym! My experience has been that there is a place for every level of fitness and ability. My wife and two kids also joined a few months after I did. The kids love the jujitsu and boxing classes. Coach Travell is my personal favorite, both his Muay Thai and Cardio Kickboxing classes are intense and well worth it. I am a teacher myself, so I can spot when someone shares their craft out of a certain level of passion and expertise. Coach Travell has the kind of heart and intensity that is contagious and makes you want to work hard and keep coming back. I plan to be at Nashville MMA for awhile. Great place.

name: Carson Wright
text: I had my first experience in an MMA gym this week. With it being my first time, naturally I was intimidated before walking through the door. However, after being greeted by the staff / coaches they made it feel like I had been training there for years. Very personable and welcoming to everyone. Coach T was a great, I have the utmost respect for him as a fighter and teacher. He made the class challenging yet understood that most of us are beginners and adapted to our skill level. I will definitely be going back.

name: Nate James
text: I've been training BJJ here since moving to Nashville 3 years ago and love the place. It's awesome that they have a full gym, plus BJJ, wrestling, judo, MMA, etc., all in one place. I've been training under BT (Bryan Tidwell) since I joined the gym and I learn something new every class I make because his coaching style is solid. He gives great instruction that is easy to follow for beginners, while still highlighting all the small details that can make a technique way more effective for more advanced students.

name: Micah Smith
text: I came in knowing nothing about BJJ. Plain and simple. After the hour-long beginner lesson was finished, I was convinced that there was no better place to receive high-quality instruction and learn both the fun and the discipline of BJJ than at Nashville MMA. Coach Shawn was both thorough and encouraging, clearly caring about every one of his students while still pushing them further and showing interest in their development. This was an incredible experience and the reason I will be coming back.

name: Mike Wargo
text: Joining this gym was a fantastic decision. I lost 15 lbs. in two months and while it's exhausting, it's worth it. I find myself looking forward to going to the kickboxing class, which I've never experienced with any other exercise routine. The instructors push you to your limit but aren't dicks about it, which, if you're out of shape (like me), you won't get discouraged. If you've got the time and the dedication, it's definitely a rewarding experience

name: Leal Legacy
text: Out of a family of 5 (soon to be 6) 3 of us train at Nashville MMA, and couldn’t be happier or more proud to be a part of the gym’s community. There is no doubt that within a few years, our whole family will be training there.The coaches are deeply skilled, deeply knowledgeable, deeply passionate, deeply patient, and are engaged with both veterans and beginners alike. We’ll be a Nashville MMA family for years to come.

name: Skylar Mosbey
text: I've been a student for 5 years. It's an excellent athletic program. The gym has great spaces to train, good equipment, and Fantastic Instructors. Like BT (Bryan Tidwell), a BJJ black belt, and an instructor with decades of experience teaching people at every skill level. He has an emphasis on movement, with new and old school techniques. Nashville MMA is an excellent place to start a fitness journey.

name: Jazmir Reyes
text: Omg the people are nice and they're serious about what they do. I feel like I can learn so much at this gym. They have jiujitsu, wrestling, Muay Thai, weight training and others. I'm going to enroll my family here we can be an MMA family and perhaps one day get in the fighting cage they have there. I'm so excited. They will be adding a sauna and ice bath soon!! So updates are happening.

name: Chirayu Marathe
text: Have been going to this gym for 2 months and can’t recommend it enough! Fantastic facility with a ton of equipment, super friendly staff and amazing coaches! Especially recommend Coach Shawn for BJJ, he does a great job of breaking down techniques and providing guidance. Would also recommend Coach Ronnie for Muay Thai, his classes are always very educational and so much fun!

name: Gavin Goralnick
text: Austin is such a good dude!! If you’re in Nashville and you’re looking for a CrossFit style workout that is constantly changing and challenging you then give his classes a shot! He is extremely helpful to those just starting out while also keeping it fun for the more experienced people. Also check out his intro to MMA and boxing classes as well. Solid group!!

name: Dean Braden
text: Having moved a lot these last years for work purposes I’ve visited and enrolled in many martial arts gyms and I can say with out doubt that Nashville MMA is among the best for Jujitsu, Muay Thai and self defense. In combining the arts, the MMA training at Nashville MMA is unmatched anywhere! My experience at Nashville MMA has been excellent!

name: Michelle G
text: Amazing gym! Almost a year in and I've met some very wonderful people. Getting to be part of a community of athletes that love what they do. Coaches? Top notch! I've learned a lot and continue to see my improvement. My son and I take part in Jiu Jitsu which has been an amazing sport! Definitely a place to check out!

name: Aadonis Kauterman
text: It is a great environment with different classes all day. From boxing to judo. Great place to turn yourself into an animal! But also learning proper techniques. I have learned so much in just this 1 month that I been here and I look forward to what I can learn and possible opportunities in the future with this gym!

name: Dante Reyna
text: One stop shop for everything MMA. Coach Tra'vell brings his unique class of Muay Thai and fighting into the class. You really get a sense of the years of experiences the coaches have. Have been training for about a year now and can definitely say I don't see myself training anywhere else anytime soon.

name: Garrett Bowen
text: Had a fantastic time on my introduction tour and class. Staff was very knowledgeable and the facility is astounding. You can tell that the coaches are experts and have the ability to coach not only the beginners but experts as well. I look forward to the experience of growing with Nashville MMA.

name: Ariel Zeigler
text: Amazing gym, amazing coaches, amazing team. They push your limits, but are not out to kill you… If you’re a fighter, you know what that means. I’ve trained around the world and this is probably the top five gyms that I’ve ever been to. Try it out, and you will know exactly what I’m speaking of!

name: Daniel Mancini
text: Been training for about 6 months, taking MMA classes with Coach Mike and the occasional No-Gi BJJ class. It's been a great experience - I learn something new each day and always leave feeling better than when I arrived. Great facilities, too, and all-around friendly people. Highly recommend!

name: Kim Diehl
text: I've been going to Nashville MMA Training Camp since 2020 and I love it! Not only is it a great place to meet cool people but the workouts are killer!!! I truly have seen a huge change and have gotten so much stronger since working out here. Austin and Tim are truly the BEST trainers!!

name: Drew Davenport
text: I have been working out here for several years. Great gym with great people. The Iron Pile class coached by Coach Austin is the best class they offer. Coach Austin does a great job of designing the work outs to be challenging but also manageable regardless of your fitness level.

name: Steven Modlin
text: My son has been in martial arts since he was 6, he is now 15. We have been all over map to train. This is hands down one of the best gyms we have been in!!! Very knowledgeable coaching staff with a proven track record. If you are looking for a gym, this is the place to be

name: Katrina Owens
text: My son been going here for a month now the trainer Shaun is awesome he is great with kids and his patience is on point. Overall I would totally recommend this place. The front desk staff is amazing also. But Shaun rocks 😃 your kid would be a champion with his training.

name: Amanda Benjamin
text: Nashville MMA is like a second home! So many awesome people and that have each others' backs, having higher ranked belts and amazing teachers, we learn a lot even in bigger classes. 10/10 highly recommend. Plus we have some of the highest ranked fighters on the state!

name: Brayden Walker
text: Coach Travell is a top notch instructor with a real passion for Muay Thai. Coach T knows his stuff and is always available for questions after class. The staff and students are all very nice and welcoming. I was hooked after my first class. Definitely try it out !

name: Nick Britt
text: The difference between this gym and the other gyms that want to be this gym is experience. Actual competitors teaching classes. Come in acting like a badass and you might leave with a broken arm, but if you ditch your ego, they are the coolest cats in town.

name: Jay Terry
text: Don't bother going to any of the other MMA studios in the city. If you want to become an elite level fighter with trainers that will tailor their teaching to your specific needs, Nashville MMA is the only place to go. Ask for Coach Tra' vell specifically

name: Rosy Argueta
text: I’ve been going for a few months and I am hooked. The facility is top notch but it is the coaches and the energy in each class that keep me coming. Coach Tim and Coach Austin push me everyday to be better and get stronger. So glad I found this place!!!

name: Sam White
text: Coach Shawn does a wonderful job of breaking BJJ techniques down into easy to learn parts. He then brings everything together and gives great feedback on how you can improve. I highly recommend Nashville MMA to anyone looking for a home gym.

name: Hamza Hassaballa
text: Class was super fun, enjoyed it thoroughly! Coach Austin is very experienced and it shows, but he also has a welcoming approach which is appreciated as a first timer. The facility is quite impressive overall, would easily recommend👍🏾

name: Randall Phillips
text: Nashville MMA is the best place around to train. Everyone there is welcoming, friendly and top notch, all lead by one of the best BJJ competitors and professors there is: Shawn Hammonds. Give it a try, you will not be disappointed!

name: Jonathan Bran
text: Nashville mma gym has amazing coaches and also has a great schedule. Always have great workouts. Kids class is so amazing. My kid learns so much and also gets great exercise.They push you to go hard and never let you give up!!

name: Allison Toth
text: Really enjoyed the Galentines event! They did a great job creating a safe place for women to learn self-defense. The trainers were super professional, and I had a great time learning and meeting the other people who attended.

name: Joel Gage
text: Great place to learn and train! I have been working with Coach Mike for over a year and a half now and it has been a great experience. He is an encyclopedia of multiple disciplines and a skilled teacher. Highly recommend!

name: shannon staggs
text: Today was my 6 yr old son’s trial class for Jiu-jitsu training. Staff was very friendly, helpful and informative. Instructors were patient and worked well with the kids. Clean facility. We signed him up for more classes.

name: Lily Martinez
text: I love going to the gym and learning more about ju jitsu and boxing! The coaches are great! I always have fun learning and meeting new people. I’ve learned so much over years training there and feel very confident.

name: Luis Daniel Oliveros
text: I've been here for almost 3 years. It's the best gym in town. If you're looking to learn martial arts or just stay active, this is your place. All the people here are really nice and cool (trainers and staff). :)

name: Kelly Cofield
text: The gym is incredibly welcoming! I mostly participate in the fitness classes and always get a good sweat. Our morning coach, Austin Tucker, is fantastic. He pushes you and is also fun. It's a great community.

name: Jared Riley
text: Fantastic people. Out of town affiliate, down for training. Professor Hammonds is a beast and the world knows it. If you are looking to sharpen your skills, look no further, this is the place to be.

name: Joseph Kelley
text: NashvilleMMA is an great place with great people. I can train for my own enjoyment while the next person might be a pro fighter! Everyone is supportive of one another, and that's what's so cool.

name: Zack Murphy
text: Excellent facility for all thing MMA. Very knowledgeable and helpful staff. They can train people of all skill levels, ages, and backgrounds. Great BJJ, Muay Thai, Tactical Defense, MMA classes!

name: Gabriela Hinojosa
text: Had an amazing time at Nashville MMA for the Galentine’s Self-Defense class! All of the instructors were so knowledgeable, patient, and kind. Wonderful experience, Nash MMA is the best!!! 😊💕

name: Bobby Martin
text: This is hands down the best gym and gym atmosphere in Nashville. Feels like I’m training in college again! Already recommended to some friends and they signed up instantly.. loving it here!

name: Dashawn
text: Nashville mma is the spot for if you wanna learn real self defense or even compete. Coach Travell helped me feel more welcomed, and is a very good teacher. As a result, I wanna compete too.

name: Steven Coble
text: This is the best gym around. The best coaches and team mates. Very family oriented, and a great place for children to learn how to defend themselves. So if u want the best we are the best.

name: Amanda Wollum
text: I have both of my boys in the Black Belt Club at Nashville MMA - it has been the best thing ever for them. They fight with each other less, and have gained so much skill. Bravo!

name: Blair Adams
text: Nashville MMA is hands the best Mixed Martial Arts gym in the city. The Coaches are elite (many are professional fighters or grapplers) and the facilities are state of the art.

name: Saburo H
text: Great instructor, students, and facility. The instructor and all students welcomed one time walk-in guy like me. (Because just passing by the town on the way to AZ from NC.)

name: Zakkery Root
text: This place has it all. The rounds at open mat were excellent, very welcoming and friendly environment. If I were a Nashville resident I would be training here permanently.

name: Bigg N
text: My family, my brothers and sisters, a bunch great people work and train at NMMA! I've been there since 100 Oaks Mall 10 years ago and would recommend this gym to anyone !

name: Derek Bryan
text: This is the premier MMA facility in the SE!! Great instructors with decades of expertise in every facet of the game! The kids program is incredible. I call it home

name: patcrumpton
text: By far the best gym in and around Nashville. Whether you’re training to be a fighter, get in shape or learn self-defense Nashville MMA is the place to be!

name: Roy Parker
text: I went for the No gi am class , people were friendly, class was great. Big gym, a lot to offer. Totally recommend dropping in if you’re in Nashville

name: Chase Dalton
text: This facility is awesome. Coach Tra’vell’s Muay Thai classes are informative and fun, and the BJJ classes are top notch. Definitely recommend.

name: brandon arias
text: Great experience friendly staff super clean and diverse facility beginner friendly and most of all very fun and friendly. Thanks Austin!

name: Taylor Hood
text: Game changer. Folks are amazing. Great staff. Been a member for a couple years and can’t imagine working out or training anywhere else.

name: Logan W
text: Best coaches best athletes and best people to be around period they all work hard and push each other everyday to become better

name: Richie Martinez
text: What a gym. Very clean, excellent classes, and wonderful coaches. YOU HAVE TO GO TO RONNIE’S CLASSES! He’ll get you right. 🔥🔥🔥

name: James W
text: Top notch instructors and nothing but grueling hard work. Definitely recommend this place if you want to put in the hard work.

name: Ryan De Burgh
text: I had an absolute blast in my first lesson and cannot wait for more. Real teachers with real passion for teaching these arts.

name: W S
text: Just finished my first free class and now I'm hooked. Already getting a member and putting time in my schedule for classes.

name: Brandon Hendricks
text: Best MMA gym in the area. Really appreciate that they have morning and afternoon classes in addition to the night ones.

name: Yabetz Cohen-Peretz
text: If you're a fighter or just looking for a great work out...... you must check out Nashville Mixed Martial Arts Academy.

name: Pete Blackwell
text: Great gym to train at and Iv been around the u.s. in many different ones. This is one of the top places to train.

name: Joshua Daniel
text: I have been here one day so far and already it feels I have found a new family it's a great environment to learn.

name: Damien Horne
text: Love all the coaches and the staff here! Super helpful and attentive! I’m enjoying learning and training!

name: Kristin H
text: Super friendly and welcoming vibe... awesome place! :) looking forward to coming back when I'm in town...

name: Brycen Newman
text: Great fundamentals, doesn’t make you feel new. Good explanation with open trainers and other members.

name: David Lashley
text: Great coaches, an energetic gym atmosphere, and a helpful front desk, Highly recommended!!!

name: Lee Clark
text: It’s a super clean place, good fighters and instructors. Zero complaints.

name: Kian Lanam
text: One of my favorite gyms for sure. Zack Hicks is a great instructor!

name: Khurshid Ismoilov
text: BT is one of the best jujitsu coach I ever know…👍👍👍

name: The 1 Armed Bandit
text: Best fight camp in Nashville!

name: Avery Davis
text: Great place to train.

name: Mark “Marky 4 Fingers” Laws
text: Best in the state
